ncnnExecutable.description: Official portable Windows build of Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan (pin this release for reproducible installs).
Official portable Ubuntu Linux build of Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan (glibc; x86-64). Requires Vulkan + Mesa or proprietary GPU drivers on the host.
ncnnExecutable.compatibilityNotes: Supports the same custom NCNN model ids as Windows, including upscayl-lite-4x when the .param/.bin pair is present under models/. Official release weights (realesrgan-x4plus, etc.) ship inside the zip; Upscayl Lite is downloaded separately.

upscaylLite4xModel.description: NCNN model pair upscayl-lite-4x (.param + .bin). Shared by Windows and Linux installs.
upscaylLite4xModel.license: Upscayl project is AGPL-3.0; model provenance is Upscayl. Verify redistribution terms before shipping this pair.
